Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline, disabled while empty/pending, inline errors (e.g. 409 'session is not active'), composer hidden when session finished. Passing check/lint; live verification pending a running hostd/agent.

Implemented hub-only Go-code-first OpenAPI generation with a typed web SDK wrapper, preserving existing hub behavior and adding generation/check scripts.
